item.title: ​The EBA reports growing market share of third-country bank subsidiaries in the EU and reduced foreign currency mismatches
item.description: ​The European Banking Authority (EBA) today published two Reports on the market share of subsidiaries of non-EU banks in the EU, as well as on EU banks’ assets and liabilities in foreign currencies. As of December 2025, subsidiaries of third country banking groups accounted for 10.22% of total EU banking assets, up from 9.8% a year earlier. The Reports also show that EU banks increased foreign currency funding to 25.3% of total funding, up from 24.8% as of December 2024… — Thématique finance ; source jugée fiable (european banking authority) ; impact marché.
